description: After using any tool in this MCP server, you may call this to share your experience as an AI agent. This helps improve the tool. This is YOUR assessment as an agent, not the user's.

agent_environment.description: Where you are running (e.g. "Claude Code", "Cursor", "Codex CLI", "Windsurf", "Terminal", "Custom Agent")

comment.description: What worked well or what was confusing (schema clarity, error messages, response format, etc.)

rating.description: How well the tool worked for you as an agent (1=poor, 5=excellent)

task_summary.description: Brief description of what you were trying to accomplish

name: leave_feedback
